item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for year-long $3 million renovation
item.description: The Stuart downtown public dock will close July 6 for renovations projected to be complete by next Fourth of July, nearly doubling capacity from 18 to 44 slips.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes July 6 for $3 million renovation to nearly double boat slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's public downtown dock will shut down beginning July 6 for a comprehensive renovation expected to wrap up by next Independence Day. The year-long project represents a significant investment in the city's waterfront infrastructure, with plans to substantially increase the facility's capacity.
